FIELDS.NAME: Community First Bank
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Compliance Officer, Community First Bank, 555-0123
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Community First Bank operates as a locally focused financial institution dedicated to serving the banking needs of individuals and small businesses in our community. We offer a wide range of services, including personal and business checking and savings accounts, loans, mortgage options, and investment advice. Our operations prioritize adherence to regulatory requirements, ensuring that we maintain effective practices to mitigate operational risks. We have implemented comprehensive employee training programs covering customer service and data security to enhance service quality and protect sensitive information. With secure, monitored vaults and restricted access to sensitive areas, we prioritize the physical security of our assets. Our commitment to community engagement is evident through our financial literacy programs and regular outreach initiatives. Overall, Community First Bank strives to provide reliable financial services while ensuring robust internal controls and regulatory adherence.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Community First Investment Advisors, LLC - a financial consulting firm focused on providing investment guidance for individuals and small businesses.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses recorded between 05/01/2022 and 06/15/2022 due to a cyber incident resulting in data breach and fraud attempts. Total amount lost was $3,500. The incident prompted an immediate review and enhancement of cybersecurity measures, and all affected parties were notified. Status: Resolved, with no further repercussions.
FIELDS.Combined Single Limit: $1,000,000 Combined Single Limit with a $5,000 deductible
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM; Saturday, 9:00 AM - 12:00 PM; Closed on Sundays.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Steel security vault, Class B, UL listed.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Secure fencing around the property and a trained security watchman on-site during business hours to enhance safety and deter unauthorized access.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Community First Bank does not engage in the storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting of hazardous materials. Our operations are strictly focused on providing financial services to the community without involvement in hazardous materials activities.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Community First Bank does not sponsor any athletic teams, focusing primarily on financial services and community engagement through educational programs.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The compliance officer checks and verifies these certificates as part of our risk management process.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – There have been no indictments or convictions related to fraud, bribery, arson, or any arson-related crimes connected to this or any other property associated with the applicant.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Community First Bank has not had any policies or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior three years. Our operations have maintained a strong compliance record, and we remain committed to upholding regulatory standards.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Community First Bank does not lease employees to or from other employers; our staffing is exclusively managed internally to maintain control over operations and compliance.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Community First Bank carries Workers’ Compensation insurance to ensure compliance with legal requirements and to protect against potential employee-related risks.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – Community First Bank also owns and operates Community First Investment Advisors, LLC, a financial consulting firm focused on providing investment guidance for individuals and small businesses. This additional business aligns with our mission to enhance financial support within the community.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Community First Bank does not have any other insurance policies with this company currently listed. The only policy in effect is CFB-2023-001.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Community First Bank is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our operations are strictly focused on providing financial services to the community.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Community First Bank does not rent or loan equipment to others; our operations are focused solely on providing banking and financial services to the community.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Community First Bank has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien in the past five years. The institution maintains a strong financial standing and complies with regulatory requirements.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Community First Bank does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals as our operations are strictly focused on providing financial services without involvement in hazardous materials.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Community First Bank does not have any known catastrophe exposure as our operations are confined to providing financial services without involvement in activities that would lead to such risks. We maintain strong internal controls and compliance measures to mitigate potential hazards.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Community First Bank has not had any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The institution maintains a strong compliance framework and prioritizes ethical hiring practices.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Community First Bank currently has no uncorrected fire code violations. The institution prioritizes safety and compliance with fire codes, ensuring that all necessary inspections and corrections are addressed promptly.
FIELDS.compliance_program: "compliance_program": "Community First Bank has a documented and up-to-date compliance program that ensures adherence to regulatory requirements and reduces the risk of violations."
